preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is between 1 and 99.
The length of the input string s is a multiple of 3.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the input string s are uppercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(s)) if s[i] != 'SOS'[i % 3])
postconditions.description: The function returns the number of characters in s that differ from the corresponding characters in the expected SOS message.
